title: Which coordinate frame?
description: The laser is mounted 0.2 m ahead of base_link. Find its origin in odom, including when the robot is rotated.
steps: Inspect ros2 topic echo /tf --once. The tree is odom → base_link → laser_link.
Create a Buffer and TransformListener. In a timer, request lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Report translation.x and translation.y using report_transform. The target frame is the frame in which you want the answer.
hints: Wait for transforms: catch TransformException on early callbacks.
Do not simply add 0.2 to odom x; the mounting offset rotates with the robot.
The buffer composes both edges. Here it supports latest planar transforms, not historical queries.

listener = TransformListener(buffer, node)

node.create_timer(0.2, tick)
rclpy.spin(node)
